description: Start captioning with Moonshine Tiny Streaming (34M, fast load) as soon as a recording or launch begins, then hot-swap to the selected Small/Medium model once loaded, without losing or duplicating text at the switch (swap at a line boundary). Optional polish; measure whether B3 load time makes it unnecessary.

comments.text: Measured, decided not to build (the ticket's own criterion: 'measure whether B3 load time makes it unnecessary'). Added ?bench=live&nowarm=1 (jj rev 'Dev bench: nowarm=1 records at launch'). Simulator, jfk, recording started immediately at launch with models downloaded, 2 runs each: Small first caption 1.88 / 1.85 s after Start (Small load 2044/2053 ms; speech during load is caught up from the ring), Tiny 1.00 / 1.10 s (load ~1.47 s). Warm Small: 1.40 s (kdl.11). A Tiny-first hot swap would save ~0.8 s once per app launch at the cost of a second 45 MB download, a second model in memory (bad for the iOS budget) and switching streams mid-line. Won't do; revisit only if device runs (kdl.13) show Small loading far slower on phones.

title: Tiny-first live captions while the selected streaming model loads
